Reasoning Begins with Alignment

4:51VC33October 24, 2026
Watch on YouTubeYanik_AI channel

About this episode

VC33 provides the setting for a discussion of alignment. Here the term includes expectations that a world has coherent rules, conventions that make objects recognizable, and assumptions about its designer’s intentions. Yannick examines when an acquired principle deserves continued use, and how consistency can support that trust. The episode connects these expectations to the symbols, goals, and values supplied by the people developing an intelligent system.

  • Coherent world rules
  • Shared conventions
  • Trust in acquired principles
